# Decodo

> Decodo (formerly Smartproxy) is a proxy and web scraping platform for large-scale public web data collection. It provides residential, ISP, datacenter, and mobile proxies, as well as Web Scraping API (including Web, SERP, eCommerce, and social media targets) that help businesses bypass IP bans and CAPTCHAs, enabling efficient and reliable access to public web data. Decodo serves market research, eCommerce, SEO, and data science teams with scalable networks, granular geo-targeting, and developer-focused tooling.

## Proxy types

- [Residential Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/residential-proxies): Residential proxies from $2/GB with global IP coverage
- [Static Residential Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/static-residential-proxies): Static residential (ISP-backed) proxies from $0.27/IP
- [ISP Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/isp-proxies): Residential ISP proxies from $0.27/IP with free trial
- [Mobile Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/mobile): 5G/4G/3G/LTE mobile proxies with free trial
- [Datacenter Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/datacenter-proxies): Datacenter proxies from $0.026/IP with free trial
- [Sticky Residential Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/sticky-residential-proxies): Residential proxies with persistent sticky sessions
- [YouTube Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/youtube-proxies): Proxies optimized for YouTube access and automation

## Proxy features & options

- [Buy Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/buy): Buy proxy servers from $0.45/GB
- [Proxy Features](https://decodo.com/proxies/features): Overview of Decodo proxy network features
- [Cheap Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/cheap): Budget proxies from $0.026/IP
- [SOCKS5 Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/socks5): SOCKS5 residential, dedicated, and other proxy types
- [Rotating Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/rotating-proxies): Unlimited rotating proxies with free trial
- [Private Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/private-proxies): Dedicated private IPs from $1.15/IP
- [IPv4 Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/ipv4-proxies): IPv4 proxies across 195+ locations
- [Unlimited Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/unlimited-proxies): Unlimited bandwidth proxies
- [Dedicated Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/dedicated-proxies): Fast, secure, private dedicated proxies
- [UDP Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/udp-proxies): High-speed UDP proxy servers
- [Shared Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/shared-proxies): Shared proxy pool for lower-cost use cases
- [Site Unblocker](https://decodo.com/proxies/site-unblocker): Access restricted content with the Site Unblocker

## AI & LLM Solutions

- [AI Hub](https://decodo.com/ai): Decodo's AI solutions hub for data, agents, and LLM workflows

- [High-Speed Proxies](https://decodo.com/proxies/high-speed-proxies): High-speed proxies for real-time AI agent and scraping workloads

## Web Scraping API

Decodo's Web Scraping API is an all-in-one scraping solution. SERP, eCommerce, and social media are task types of this same API, the pages below describe its type-specific capabilities and targets, not separate products.

- [Web Scraper API](https://decodo.com/scraping/web): Scrape any website with the Web Scraper API

- [eCommerce Scraper API](https://decodo.com/scraping/ecommerce): Scrape any online store
- [Social Media Scraper API](https://decodo.com/scraping/social-media): Scrape social media platforms at scale
- [Amazon Scraper](https://decodo.com/scraping/ecommerce/amazon): Amazon product data scraper API
- [Amazon Price Scraper](https://decodo.com/scraping/ecommerce/amazon/price): Dedicated Amazon price scraping endpoint

What is Decodo?

Decodo is a web data infrastructure platform for collecting public web data. It provides proxy networks and managed scraping solutions, including Decodo’s all-in-one Web Data API.

Is Decodo the same company as Smartproxy?

Yes, if you used Smartproxy before, you’re in the right place. Smartproxy officially became Decodo in April 2025. It’s the same company, team, infrastructure, and proxy network, now under a new name that reflects our broader web data platform.

Just be careful with the old name: Smartproxy.org isn’t us. It’s an impersonator and has no connection to Decodo, our team, or our infrastructure. The only official Decodo website is Decodo.com.

Does Decodo offer a free trial?

Yes! Decodo offers a 3-day free trial for proxies, as well as a free starter plan for its Web Data API that includes $5 in testing credits (up to 10k requests) with no credit card required to get started.

What kind of data can I collect with Decodo?

You can collect public web data: products, reviews, listings, search results, competitor content, news, and more. Decodo also offers ready-made scraping templates for targets like Google, Amazon, and other popular websites.

How do I install and use Decodo’s browser extension?

Decodo’s Chrome and Firefox extensions let you configure and manage proxies directly from your browser. For installation and setup instructions, check out our guides for Chrome and Firefox.

Where can I find independent reviews of Decodo?

You can find independent reviews of Decodo (formerly Smartproxy) across several platforms, including:

  • Proxyway for detailed hands-on reviews and performance testing. It rates Decodo 9.3/10 and includes independent tests of its Web Scraping API, residential, mobile, ISP, and datacenter proxies.
  • TechRadar for independent editorial review covering Decodo’s proxy network, features, pricing, and usability.
  • G2 for verified user reviews. Decodo is rated 4.6/5 from 700+ reviews.
  • Trustpilot for verified user reviews. Decodo is rated 4.2/5 from 2K+ reviews.

How large is Decodo’s residential IP pool?

Decodo’s residential proxy network includes 115M+ ethically-sourced IPs across 195+ locations.

Do I need a credit card to start using Web Data API?

No. You can start using Web Data API with a free starter plan without a credit card. Sign up, test your requests, and upgrade when you need more capacity.

Is Decodo’s Web Data API good for AI workflows?

Yes. Web Data API supports AI-focused workflows with LLM-ready Markdown and structured JSON formats (where applicable), plus integrations with MCP, LangChain, n8n, and OpenClaw. The MCP server lets AI agents use Decodo’s data collection tools directly, while structured outputs can be used in RAG pipelines and other AI applications.

Do proxies really provide anonymity?

A proxy masks your device’s IP by routing traffic through another IP. The level of anonymity depends on the proxy and how it’s configured, so not every proxy provides the same level of privacy. Decodo’s proxies are designed to mask your original IP and support location-specific access.

What is the difference between a proxy server and a VPN?

A proxy routes traffic through another IP, typically at the application or connection level. A VPN routes your device’s traffic through an encrypted tunnel, protecting the data in transit as well as masking your IP. Proxies are generally better suited for tasks that require specific IPs, locations, or per-application control, while VPNs are designed primarily for securing a device’s internet connection.
